_meta.indication: CHANTIX is indicated as an aid to smoking cessation treatment.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 12-week trial with Zyban (bupropion 150 mg BID) as active comparator and double-blind post-treatment follow-up to Week 52
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects smoking at least 10 cigarettes per day who were motivated to stop smoking
pivotal_trials.endpoint: 4-week Continuous Quit Rate (CQR) during the last four weeks of treatment (Weeks 9-12), confirmed biochemically by exhaled CO ≤ 10 ppm
pivotal_trials.result: 4-week CQR (Weeks 9-12): Varenicline 44.4% vs Placebo 17.7% (OR 3.91, 95% CI 2.74, 5.59; p<0.0001) and vs Zyban 29.5% (OR 1.96, 95% CI 1.42, 2.72; p<0.0001)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, identical 12-week trial with Zyban as active comparator and double-blind post-treatment follow-up to Week 52
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects smoking at least 10 cigarettes per day who were motivated to stop smoking
pivotal_trials.endpoint: 4-week Continuous Quit Rate (CQR) during the last four weeks of treatment (Weeks 9-12), confirmed by exhaled CO ≤ 10 ppm
pivotal_trials.result: 4-week CQR (Weeks 9-12): Varenicline 44.0% vs Placebo 17.7% (OR 3.85, 95% CI 2.69, 5.50; p<0.0001) and vs Zyban 30.0% (OR 1.89, 95% CI 1.37, 2.61; p<0.0001)

key_safety: The most common adverse event was nausea (30% at 1 mg BID vs 10% placebo following titration); other common AEs (>5% and twice placebo rate) were sleep disturbance, constipation, flatulence, and vomiting. Treatment discontinuation due to AEs was 12% (CHANTIX) vs 10% (placebo).
target_moa: Varenicline is a partial agonist selective for the α4β2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor subtype. Its binding produces agonist activity while simultaneously preventing nicotine from binding to α4β2 receptors, thereby blocking nicotine's activation of the central mesolimbic dopamine system believed to underlie the reinforcement and reward experienced upon smoking.

advisory_committee.vote: An advisory committee meeting was not considered to be necessary during this review cycle.

description.text: Added safety and efficacy data for Chantix in smokers with cardiovascular disease (CVD) and revised Medication Guide with possible side effects

citations.quote:

S-020: the safety and efficacy of Chantix in smokers with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)

description.text: Labeling update (WARNINGS/Cardiovascular Events) to include results from cardiovascular meta-analysis; no new indication added

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplement provides for revisions to the **HIGHLIGHTS, WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS /Cardiovascular Events, and PATIENT COUNSELING**, sections of the Package Insert, and **Medication Guide**, to include results from the cardiovascular meta-analysis of varenicline clinical trials.

description.text: Added drug interaction labeling on alcohol-varenicline interaction and modified the REMS (Medication Guide and REMS goal); no new indication added.

citations.quote: Supplement S-032 proposes revisions to the **DRUG INTERACTIONS** section of the Package Insert regarding a potential interaction between alcohol and varenicline and includes a proposed modification to the approved risk evaluation and mitigation strategy (REMS), including revisions to the Medication Guide and revisions to the Chantix REMS goal.

description.text: Added safety and efficacy data for varenicline for smoking cessation in patients with current or past history of major depressive disorder (MDD)

citations.quote: S-033: the safety and efficacy of varenicline for smoking cessation in patients with current or past history of major depressive disorder (MDD)

description.text: Added dosing guidance supporting a reduce-to-quit paradigm via changes to Dosage and Administration and Clinical Studies sections

citations.quote: S-039: Changes to the **DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION**, and **CLINICAL STUDIES** sections of the Package Insert, and modification to the approved risk evaluation and mitigation strategy (REMS) for Chantix, comprising of revisions to the **MEDICATION GUIDE**, to support the reduce-to-quit paradigm.

description.text: Updated labeling with neuropsychiatric safety data from a Phase 4 trial and removed the Boxed Warning-related REMS/Medication Guide requirement

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA proposes changes to the package insert based on clinical trial data from the study titled, "A Phase 4, Randomized, Double-Blind, Active and Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study Evaluating the Neuropsychiatric Safety and Efficacy of 12 Weeks Varenicline Tartrate 1 mg BID and Bupropion Hydrochloride 150 mg BID for Smoking Cessation in Subjects with and Without a History of Psychiatric Disorders"; the supplement also proposes corresponding changes to the Medication Guide, and provides for proposed modification to the approved REMS for Chantix (varenicline).

description.text: Labeling revisions on the safety of varenicline use during pregnancy, based on required postmarketing Pregnancy Cohort study A3051078

citations.quote: **S-045:** labeling revisions based on the results of the “required postmarketing study commitment” Pregnancy Cohort study A3051078, regarding the safety of varenicline use during pregnancy.

description.text: Updated Use in Specific Populations and Clinical Pharmacology based on pediatric studies in adolescents ages 12-16 for smoking cessation (PREA/PWR fulfillment)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for changes to Sections 8.4 USE IN SPECIFIC POPULATIONS, and 12.3 CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY based on studies conducted to fulfill your Pediatric Written Request (PWR), and Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA) Postmarketing Requirement.

basis.text: Priority review was requested and granted; varenicline, a first-in-class NME, was judged to offer a significant efficacy improvement compared to marketed smoking cessation products.

citations.quote: At the time of NDA submission, the applicant requested a priority review for this product. This request was granted.

summary.text: CHANTIX (varenicline), a first-in-class new molecular entity, was received November 10, 2005 and granted priority review as a significant improvement over marketed smoking cessation products; it was approved as an aid to smoking cessation without accelerated approval, orphan, fast track, or breakthrough designations, with no advisory committee meeting.

citations.quote: Varenicline tartrate is a first-in-class, new molecular entity (NME) under development by Pfizer as an aid to smoking cessation.
At the time of NDA submission, the applicant requested a priority review for this product. This request was granted.
An advisory committee meeting was not considered to be necessary during this review cycle.

requirement.text: Deferred pediatric study (PREA) to determine the multiple-dose pharmacokinetics of varenicline in pediatric patients to determine appropriate doses for efficacy and safety evaluations in adolescent smokers, ages 12 through 16, inclusive.

citations.quote: To conduct a study to determine the multiple-dose pharmacokinetics of varenicline in pediatric patients in order to determine the appropriate doses for efficacy and safety evaluations in adolescent smokers, ages 12 through 16, inclusive, to determine the adverse event profile in adolescent patients, and to establish whether there is any age group (or weight group) for whom varenicline is so poor

requirement.text: Deferred pediatric study (PREA) to determine whether varenicline, as part of an overall smoking cessation program, is effective in achieving and maintaining smoking cessation in tobacco-addicted adolescents, ages 12 through 16, inclusive.

citations.quote: To conduct a study to determine whether varenicline, as part of an overall smoking cessation program, is effective in achieving and maintaining smoking cessation in tobacco-addicted adolescents, ages 12 through 16, inclusive, to determine a safe and effective dose, and to document the ability of treating physicians to select appropriate patients.

requirement.text: Prospective epidemiologic cohort study in pregnant women who are smokers exposed to varenicline at conception or any time during pregnancy, to assess potential risk to the fetus and/or live born infant.

citations.quote: To conduct a prospective epidemiologic cohort study in pregnant women who are smokers and who are exposed to varenicline at the time of conception or any time during pregnancy. This information will be used to assess the potential risk to the fetus and/or live born infant.
